name: K-T2d
description: The diagnosis of the black own clouds of K-T2 start 42 (.local/plans/atmospheres/K-T2-black-clouds-diagnosis.md, 'One game start would settle the rest'). One start, the variant plain only, no timing, about 4 minutes of scenario (the limit is 8). Same pins and guards as K-T2 (raytracing Off, frame generation off, quality NativeAA, window 1707x960, no frame cap, EVE removed, weatherEffects/genEnabled/enabled on, the log guard, the pictures collected); no GPU profiler (its markers change the camera's buffers). The clock step emits the cover of all 48 candidate hours (T09.cover.<ut>) and picks two universal times with the sun at about the same height, both 30 to 55 degrees up (else both 15 to 60; T09d.sun_band_narrow, sun_band_min_deg / sun_band_max_deg, sun_elev_diff_deg): the hour with the lowest cover available ('low', band 0.2 to 0.4) and the hour nearest 0.7 (band 0.6 to 0.8, 'high') that is at least 0.15 above it; a pick outside its band is flagged by T09d.cover_off_band, and the start fails only where no pair is 0.15 apart (T09d.covers_distinct). At each, in the views ground (200 m, looking 18 degrees up) and above (8300 m, 25 degrees down), poses held (the vessel's centre of mass within 5 m of the point for 30 frames before each capture, 20 m at most at the read; expected: all frames pose_ok) and verified at every capture: the baseline frame (the pass runs with no layer drawn), cloud.sunGain 1, 4 and 16 (one frame each; g64 was dropped for the coverage variants, the sun colour of the pass read back and checked), and aid 4 (direct light, light taps, ambient as colours) at gain 1. Every frame is read as raw target values (no gamma step) and measured in three regions: the sky above the horizon (the horizon row from the camera's pitch and field of view), the sunlit sea or ground below it, and the deck (the pixels the pass changed against the baseline); the vessel's box is left out. Rows T09d.<view>.<cover>.<gain>.<stat> with sky_/ground_/deck_ n, p10, median, p90, r, g, b, clipped; deck_fraction; peak; the ratios deck_over_off_sky, deck_over_off_ground (the white reference: the sunlit sea of the baseline), sky_over_off_sky, ground_over_off_ground, deck_vs_g1 (gain 4, 16, 64 over gain 1). The light and the target are logged at the first drawn frame and every 30 s ('T09d env <key>: ...': Sun.Instance.sunLight and the other directional lights, the frame's sun colour and direction with its elevation, the ambient mode and values, Scatterer, SunAirHeightM, allowHDR, the camera target's format, the colour space, the camera's distance from the planet's centre against the vessel's altitude, the composition, the command buffers on the camera and its components); the first set is also in rows T09d.env.<key>. Pictures: half size, t09-diag1707-<view>_<cover>-<gain>-1707x960-natural-half.png (aid: -aid-direct-half). EXPECTED RESULTS, written before the run (values are raw luminance of the camera target; start 42 at cover 0.514 measured the ground sky at median 0.020, p90 0.063, the cloud areas from above at 0.118 next to a sea of 0.72, the baseline sky at 0.31 / 0.49 / 0.69; the offline raw value of the Player at sun 0.844 to 1.0 is 0.063 to 0.083 on the ground and 0.17 to 0.20 from above). PREDICTION A, units or composition is the cause and nothing after the pass clamps or darkens: the deck median rises in proportion to the gain until the target clips at 1.0 (ground view, high cover: gain 1 about 0.02 to 0.08, gain 4 about 0.08 to 0.32, gain 16 about 0.32 to 1.3 and clipped at 1.0 where the target is not HDR, gain 64 clipped at 1.0; deck_vs_g1 at gain 4 is 3.2 to 4.4; deck_over_off_sky climbs from 0.04 to 0.15 at gain 1 through the sky's level (1.0) at a gain of 6 to 25; above view: gain 1 about 0.1 to 0.2, gain 4 about 0.4 to 0.8, gain 16 clipped), and the deck over the baseline sunlit sea at gain 1 is the factor the sun's unit is short by (start 42: 0.16 from above, 0.03 on the ground). PREDICTION B, something after the pass clamps, darkens or replaces the colour (an image effect, Scatterer's extinction, the composite not being rgb + dst x (1 - alpha), a different target): the deck median stays near its gain-1 value or saturates at a constant whatever the gain (deck_vs_g1 at gain 4 under 2, gain 16 about the same as gain 4, deck_over_off_sky at gain 16 under 0.2, the deck's peak does not follow the gain); the checks on the sun colour of the pass (it follows the gain) rule out a gain that never arrived. The aid 4 frame separates the two inside the pass: its direct light (r) at gain 1 should be of the order of the sun colour's luminance 0.844 times the transmittance (tenths) under A or B alike; a deck median 10 times below it points at what the pass does with the light or at what follows it, while a direct light as small as the deck points at the light the pass is given (the T09d env lines name the sun light, the ambient and the colour space). At the low cover (about 0.3) the deck is broken or absent (deck_fraction 0 to 0.5; no deck rows is a legitimate result), and the baseline shows the clear sky for the first time; the point of the second cover is the deck fraction and the sky_over_off_sky of a sky the pass leaves alone (1.0). A diagnosis always yields data: a pose that is not the view's (T09d.<view>.<cover>.placed_ok, <gain>.pose_ok, T09d.frames_pose_ok / frames_pose_bad) is flagged and the frame is read and saved anyway (kt2d.py leaves such frames out of the verdict); only a lost scene or a dead vessel ends the start. The cover scan reads 48 hourly and 110 far candidates (7800 s steps, 10 days); the product has no override of the cloud cover, so when no hour is under 0.4 the nearest is taken and T09d.cover_off_band is 1. START 44 FOUND (2026-11-12): prediction A; ground high deck median 0.0145 / 0.0584 / 0.219 / 0.755 at gain 1 / 4 / 16 / 64 next to a sky of 0.458 and a sunlit sea of 0.443 (sun 15.6 degrees up, sun colour luminance 0.415), proportional to the gain. THE FIX (CloudOutputStage): the pass is radiometric and Unity's legacy lights have no 1/pi, so the pass is given pi times the scene's sun colour (cloud.sunUnit, ambient untouched), and its radiance is encoded relative to the sun's display value W in the final composite, D = W (c * exposure / W) ^ (1 / gamma) (cloud.exposure 1, cloud.outputGamma 2.2; gamma 1 = off). CHANGED IN THIS SERIES: the gain ladder g1 g4 g16 runs with the stage forced off (cloud.sunUnit 1, cloud.outputGamma 1), so its rows and verdict are start 44's; after it, per view and cover, three more frames at gain 1: u1 (sun unit pi, no gamma), p1 (the product's defaults), pe2 (the product's stage at exposure 2); and rows T09d.<view>.<cover>.layer<l>_map_cover / _map_type, the pass's own map values at the site per layer (the cover the series picks is the field's at 3 km; the rain deck reads its map at its mid height). EXPECTED FOR THE STAGE, written before the start (ground view, high cover, same pick as start 44: raw deck 0.0145 at gain 1, sea 0.443, sky 0.458): u1 deck median 0.0456 (u1 / g1 = pi, 3.0 to 3.3; deck over the sea 0.10); p1 deck median 0.152 (0.12 to 0.19), p1 over the sea 0.34 (0.27 to 0.43), over the sky 0.33 (0.27 to 0.40): well below the sea, as a thick base lit by diffuse light is, and no longer 3 percent of it; pe2 deck median 0.208, pe2 / p1 = 2 ^ (1 / 2.2) = 1.37 (1.30 to 1.40). Above view, high cover (raw deck 0.311 = ambient about 0.20 in display units + direct about 0.11; sea 0.432): u1 about 0.55 (u1 / g1 1.5 to 2.6 because the ambient is not scaled), p1 about 0.47 (0.35 to 0.60), p1 over the sea 1.1 (0.8 to 1.4: a cloud top is about as bright as the sunlit sea). Not changed by the stage: the sea and the sky (ground_over_off_ground and sky_over_off_sky 1.0), the aid frame (the stage skips aid views; its direct light is pi times start 44's because the sun colour is). The stage's expected numbers are checked in tests/ReDefinition.Tests/Atmospheres/T09/CloudOutputStageTests.cs and tools/weather_metrics/kt2d.py (stage.* rows, stage.verdict 1 = inside the bands). EXPECTED FOR THE COVER MAP (CloudCoverModel, same test file): a map value of 0.473 under the rain deck (coverage 0.5, edge 0.2, noise amount 0.3) closes more than 60 percent of the sky for the Stratus type at 18 degrees up and at the zenith, 0.3 closes under 45 percent, 0.6 closes over 95 percent: the closed share is a ramp 0.3 wide in the map value, centred where the coverage threshold puts it (0.41 to 0.43 for half the sky at map 0.5, the file has 0.5); layer<l>_map_cover tells which value the shape actually saw. Measured in the same package; the result is read from the rows, no constant is fitted. COVERAGE VARIANTS (owner decision open: the rain deck's coverage 0.5 of the file against about 0.42): after p1, per view and cover, the product's stage at gain 1 with the runtime key cloud.coverageShift (CloudCoverShift, default 0 = the file) at -0.08 (tag c42, coverage 0.42) and -0.15 (c35, coverage 0.35); p1 is the shift-0 frame. Rows per frame: sky_closed_share and ground_closed_share (a proxy from the picture, no alpha is read: the share of the region's samples whose largest channel changed by 0.15 or more against the baseline, T09Readout.ClosedChange, about an opacity of 0.6 or more; the ground view reads the sky, the above view the ground region. START 48 FOUND (2026-11-13): the old definition, deck samples at 0.9 of the region's 90th percentile of change, read 0.07 for ground high and 0.26 for ground low where the pictures show towers and a closed sheet; and layer<l>_map_cover read 1.0 and map type 0.0 in all four layers at both covers because the layer stack held no maps (StackMapMirror now copies the fetched maps into it), so model_closed was 1 everywhere. Checked offline on the saved p1/c42/c35 pictures of the four view/cover pairs: ground low closed share 1.00 at p1, c42 and c35, ground high 0.14 / 0.00 / 0.00, above low 0.81 each), sky_deck_share, ground_deck_share, deck_fraction, the deck median, the picture (natural, and aid on the p1 frame); c42.coverage_shift, c42.rain_coverage, c42.shift_reached say that the shift reached the layer. EXPECTED, written before the run, from CloudCoverModel (Stratus of the rain deck, sigma 0.045, equivalent thickness 622 m, edge 0.2, noise amount 0.3, uniform shape noise, closed where tau > 4.605; the run writes the same numbers as T09d.<view>.<cover>.<tag>.model_closed at the measured layer map value): closed share of the sky by the layer map value, coverage 0.5 / 0.42 / 0.35, ground view (18 degrees up, slant 3.24): map 0.40: 0.47 / 0.20 / 0.00; 0.473: 0.71 / 0.44 / 0.21; 0.514: 0.85 / 0.58 / 0.35; 0.55: 0.97 / 0.70 / 0.47; 0.60: 1.00 / 0.87 / 0.63; 0.64: 1.00 / 1.00 / 0.77; at the zenith (slant 1): 0.473: 0.63 / 0.37 / 0.13; 0.514: 0.77 / 0.50 / 0.27; 0.60: 1.00 / 0.79 / 0.56; from above (25 degrees down, slant 2.37): 0.473: 0.70 / 0.43 / 0.20; 0.514: 0.83 / 0.57 / 0.33. So the shift to 0.42 lowers the closed share by 0.2 to 0.3 where the map is 0.47 to 0.6; the 15 to 25 percent of coverage 0.42 belong to a map value of about 0.40, and a closed share of one half at map 0.5 needs coverage 0.41 to 0.43. The picture's proxy is read beside the model, expected within about 0.15; at the low cover (map about 0.3) the deck is at most 13 percent closed at coverage 0.5 and none at 0.42. The time budget holds: per view 10 frames (off, g1, g4, g16, u1, p1, pe2, c42, c35, aid), 40 in all against 36 before, the limit 8 minutes. START 49 FOUND (2026-11-13): at the low cover (field 0.473; the CPU readers' layer maps 0.406 / 0.665 / 0.110 / 0.501, type 0) the ground sky is a closed sheet at every shift (closed share 0.994 / 0.984 / 0.970 for 0 / -0.08 / -0.15) while at the high cover (maps 0.859 / 0.206 / 0.661 / 0.177, type 0.229) the cumulus responds monotonically. START 50 ADDS (ground view only, both covers): for k = 0..3 a frame with only layer k drawn (Frame.LayerMask = 1 << k) at shift 0 (tag only<k>) and at -0.15 (tag only<k>c35), 16 more frames (56 in all, about 5 minutes against the limit of 8), each with closed share, deck_fraction, deck median and the natural picture, and per layer the rows T09d.ground.<cover>.L<k>.* : info (text: name, group, type name at the CPU type value, coverage, softness, noise amount, sigma, thickness), coverage, softness, eq_thickness_m, cpu_cover / cpu_type (the stack's CPU copy), gpu_cover / gpu_type (the bytes the module uploads, LayerMapStore, at the vessel's place), gpu_goal_cover / gpu_goal_type (the target the slew moves toward), shader_cover / shader_type (the same bytes where the shader's MapUv puts the camera: the map frame applied to the camera's position), gpu_minus_cpu_cover, shader_minus_cpu_cover (warnings gpu_map_differs and shader_map_differs above 0.05), model_closed_p1 / _c42 / _c35 (CloudCoverModel.LayerClosed at the CPU map value, tau above 4.6); and per cover T09d.ground.<cover>.layers.* : stack_key (text), stack_cold (the group member, 0 = rain deck), surface_temp_k, cpu / shader lat and lon and their difference. kt2d.py prints the table per layer (CPU map, GPU map, pass sample, drawn closed share at p1 and c35, model, deck fraction, deck median) and the metrics T09d.ground.<cover>.layers.sheet_layer (the layer whose own closed share is highest at shift 0) and gpu_matches_cpu (1 / -1). EXPECTED, from CloudCoverModel.LayerClosed with Clouds-Kerbin.cfg's layers (rain deck coverage 0.5 edge 0.2 noise 0.3 sigma 0.045; cumulus 0.35 / 0.15 / 0.35 / 0.05; cumulonimbus 0.12 / 0.1 / 0.4 / 0.08; cirrus 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.5 / 0.0002) at start 49's CPU maps, sky at 18 degrees up, closed where tau > 4.6, p1 / c42 / c35: low cover layer 0 (Fog at type 0, 119 m equivalent) 0.34 / 0.07 / 0.00, layer 1 (Stratocumulus, 436 m) 0.73 / 0.50 / 0.30, layer 2 0.00, layer 3 0.00 (too thin); high cover layer 0 (Fog and Stratus, 322 m) 1.00 / 1.00 / 1.00, layer 1 0.00, layer 2 0.08 / 0.00 / 0.00, layer 3 0.00. THE SHEET AT THE LOW COVER IS EXPECTED FROM LAYER 1 (the cumulus layer, Stratocumulus at type 0): it has the largest model value and is the only one still 0.30 closed at c35; the sum of all layers at the picture's opacity threshold (tau above 1) is 0.87 / 0.64 / 0.33, against the measured 0.99 / 0.98 / 0.97, so the pass draws more than the CPU maps give: a GPU map above the CPU one in layer 1 or 0 (gpu_minus_cpu_cover) would explain it. At the high cover the CPU maps make layer 0 a closed sheet (1.00) that the pictures do not show: only0 at the high cover should show it is not drawn (or its GPU map is far below 0.859). Run: python tools/atmo_series.py run K-T2d --who <name> (preflight first: python tools/atmo_series.py preflight K-T2d).

starts.description: the own pass at 1707x960 with EVE removed: two covers, views ground and above, baseline, gains 1, 4, 16, the output stage variants, the coverage variants, the layer-alone frames of the ground view and aid 4; about 5 minutes of scenario

E40 start 51, look A (shape and cover; the plan .local/plans/atmospheres/E40-plan-2026-11.md, the numbers .local/plans/atmospheres/E40-phaseO-result.md): the same two cover picks as start 50, but only the frames of the look sets. Per pair ground low, ground high, above low: the baseline, every look set of CloudLookModel (C0 current, C1 humilis at no precipitation, C2 noise (amount x0.7, scale x1.4: 0.7 / 700 m on the cumulus layer's 1.0 / 500 m of f8f8cafe; the sets were 0.55 / 3000 on the former 0.35 / 5000), C3 interior erosion, C4 the plan's cfg proposals on the cumulus layer (coverage 0.25, softness 0.35, sigma 0.035 and the noise of C2), C5 = C1 + C2 + C3) at shift 0 and -0.08 (frames k<set> and k<set>m8, the type sets wait 6 s; a look-knob change snaps the maps in the module, and the frames after a change of the types or of the forced map (kC2 after a type set, kovr, the first layer-alone frame, q50, q42) wait 2 s for that round, about 25 s more in all), the sheet layer's map forced to its value at the vessel (kovr), at the ground view the layers one at a time under the winning set (w<set>o<k>) and the rain deck at coverage 0.5 and 0.42 (q50, q42), at the high cover the rain deck alone from inside (4.6 km) and from above (l0in, l0up). Before every frame the probe writes the CPU oracle's expectation (T09d.<view>.<cover>.<frame>.expect_closed_mean / _p10 / _p90 / _sites: CloudCoverOracle over 8 sites of the noise for the camera's height, pitch and field of view, the stack's CPU maps at the vessel, the knobs as forced) and the layers' coverage maps along the view (L<k>.map_at_<d>_km, 0 to 80 km). EXPECTED RESULTS, written before the start (from the player sweeps of Phase O, E40-phaseO-result.md): (1) the closed share of a frame is a wide draw (the oracle's p10 to p90 at shift 0 is 0.21 to 0.99 for one frame at the low pick): a frame inside its expectation's spread plus 0.05 is as expected (kt2d.py: look.<set>.in_spread_s0); the game's start-50 frames (0.994 / 0.984 / 0.970 at the low pick) may lie outside what a constant map of 0.665 gives (suggestive, not proven: none of 40 oracle sites reached 0.97 at -0.15, but the measures and poses differ); (2) the forced-map frame kovr decides between two explanations: where the map of the sheet layer rises along the view (the map_at_<d>_km rows at 10 to 80 km above the vessel's 0.665) kovr reads the oracle's share and the own-map frame kC0 stays above it (kt2d.py look.ovr.map_varies_over_view 1); where the sheet stays under the forced map the pass or its settings differ from the CPU (-1); (3) the sets: C0 and C3 draw the same closed share (the interior erosion acts on the density, not on the cover; the player's tables agree to 0.002), C1 within 0.02 of C0, C2/C4/C5 closed more at maps of 0.665 and above on the former cfg 0.35 / 5000 (player: 0.91 / 0.87 / 0.93 against 0.64; that comparison no longer holds: the sets now start from 1.0 / 500 and lower the amount to 0.7, so the noise moves the threshold by 0.35 at most instead of 0.5, and the cells grow from 500 to 700 m; the expectation for a frame is the oracle's, written beside it), every set falls with the shift by at least 0.10 on average; (4) rain deck (P3): the player draws it closed (1.000) from inside at map 0.859 type 0.229, so l0in and l0up read at least 0.6 unless the game draws it differently, which is the finding; (5) rain deck coverage 0.42 against 0.5 (q42 against q50): lower by 0.2 to 0.3 where the deck is half open, no change where it is closed. A pose or a stack the probe cannot read is named, never faked. ADDED (the follow-up of start 51, tau and the rain deck's inside case): after the natural frame of C0 and of the winning set at shift 0 (per pair) and after l0in and l0up an aid frame of the optical depth is read (aid1<frame>, aid mode 1 of the layer shader; rows aidtau_n / _p10 / _median / _p90 / _closed_share (tau >= 0.92) / _deep_share (tau >= 4.6) / _saturated_share (tau >= 31.6) / _top_median, decoded against the baseline frame's colours: T09Readout.MeasureAidTau) and the oracle writes beside every expectation row the optical depth straight up (expect_tau_zenith_mean / _p10 / _p90 and expect_zenith_closed, all layers added; CloudCoverOracle.ZenithTau). kt2d.py prints per frame 'aid tau': tau closed share, deep share, median, the closed share by colour and the oracle's zenith tau. EXPECTED RESULTS, written before the run: (a) ground low, kC0: if the sheet is thick the closed share by tau is within 0.15 of the closed share by colour (0.99) and aidtau_median is 4.6 or more; if it is a thin veil that the colour measure counts as closed, the share by tau is 0.2 or more below the share by colour and aidtau_median is under 0.92; the CPU zenith expectation at map 0.665 is read from expect_tau_zenith_* of the same frame; (b) the ground view of the high pick, the rain deck alone (frame wC5o0): no longer empty. With the T13 base floor (LayerGeometry.LocalBaseTop: a type lifted onto the sea level instead of sunk under it) the wet place's Fog and Stratus lie at 0 to about 355 m instead of -404 to -49 m (CloudInsideDeckTests), so a camera at 264 m is inside the deck and the sky of wC5o0 is closed over at least 0.6 (the player had 1.000 without the height variation; the game drew 0.000 with it; if wC5o0 stays near 0, the sunk deck was not the cause); (c) l0in and l0up (4.6 km and 8.4 km, above the deck): the aid frame shows the deck's tau over the sea where white patches were drawn, deep (aidtau_deep_share over the patches 0.5 or more) and clear between them; (d) the natural pictures of the same names are unchanged by the aid frames. About 66 frames, 7 to 8 minutes of the limit; start with the sets named by -atmoLookSets and the winning set by -atmoLookWin where the budget needs it.

E40 game start 52 (the ledger's number; not the plan's look B, which is the start look52): look A of start 51 (every set at shift 0 and -0.08, kovr, the layers alone, q50/q42, l0in/l0up, the aid frames of C0 and of the winning set) plus, after the fixes since start 51: the L0 height fix (c1f3156f, dfe4b551), the Scatterer order fix (b7ed89b3, cloud.afterScatterer, default 1) and package A (42a6eeb7, HostGate). NEW FRAMES AND ROWS. (1) The order pair at above_low and ground_low, set C0, frames ord1 and ord0: cloud.afterScatterer forced 1 and 0 (Tuning key, read each frame; the pass re-reads the order of the camera's buffers once a second in OnPreRender, so each frame waits 2.5 s, counts the pass's buffer moves over 1 s (rows ord1/ord0.order_moves, order_flag, order_moving) and writes the order it read (render_order, and the log lines 'T09d env renderOrder' after the wait); checks T09d.order_<view>_<cover>_ord<flag> and T09d.order_changed_*). (2) In every natural frame the colour just above and just below the sea horizon's row over six columns (rows line_above_r/g/b, line_below_r/g/b, line_dabove_*/line_dbelow_* = change against the baseline, line_step_colour = largest channel of |above - below|; kt2d.py: line_step_over_off against the baseline's own step, order.step_on / step_off / step_vanishes). (3) The rain deck alone (wC5o0) at 264 m at both covers (existing) and now with an oracle expectation for that layer alone and an aid frame (aid1wC5o0, aid1wC5o1: the sheet layer L1 alone), and from 2.3 km above the ground (frame l0mid, view deck, high cover, aid1l0mid); the aid tau of the views that look down (deck, inside, above) is read over the sea region. (4) Rows L<k>.root_m / top_m / variation_m: the height maps' offsets at the vessel per layer. Limits: the probe 12 min (look starts), the run 17 min, about 77 frames. EXPECTED RESULTS, written before the run. (O) Order: with afterScatterer 1 the pass moves its buffers every frame (order_moves above 0, about the frame rate) and with 0 never (0); the two render_order texts differ (the pass is last with 1, before Scatterer's buffers with 0); the closed share of ord1 and ord0 equals the start-51 kC0 value at that pose within 0.10 (the order changes the cloud's colour, not where it is). Above low (the closed sheet covers both sides of the sea horizon, 0.74 in start 51): line_step_colour over the baseline's own step is at most 0.08 with 1 (no step at the horizon row) and at least 0.15 with 0 (start 51 kC0: 0.28 over the baseline's 0.06, below the row the cloud took the sea's haze: 0.46 against 0.56 above); the picture of ord0 shows the step as e40-51-above_low-kC0, the picture of ord1 does not. Ground low (the sheet is overhead, the sea below the row has no cloud): the step is not the measure there; the cloud colour above the row changes by 0.05 or less between ord1 and ord0. (L) The rain deck at 264 m with the fix: the deck lies at 0 to about 355 m at the wet site if the root offset is -500 m (the floor), so the camera is inside it. Rule for the zenith optical depth of the aid frame aid1wC5o0 (top rows, nearest the zenith the view holds, elevation 48 degrees at the top, slant factor 1.35): tau_zenith(264 m) = tau_deck_full x (top_local - 264) / (594 - 264) with top_local = 594 + root_m + top_m when the base 96 + root_m + top_m stays above 0 and the floor value (about 355 m) when it does not; the oracle's expect_tau_zenith_mean of that frame (deck alone, no height maps) is tau_deck_full (the deck from 96 to 594 m, at least 4.6 from the Phase O test), so the wet site (root -500 m) gives about 0.27 x tau_full, which is around 1.6 for a tau_full of 6; a real root offset above -140 m (L0.root_m row) gives a deck above the floor and a ratio near 1 (tau 4.6 or more), one below -500 m the same floor and the same 1.6. The closed share by colour of wC5o0 at the high pick is clearly above 0.2, at least 0.5 (the slant tau at 18 to 48 degrees elevation is 1.35 to 3.2 times the zenith tau, above the closed threshold 0.92 for every tau_zenith of 0.7 or more); at the low pick (map 0.406, type 0) it stays near 0. Whether L0 is a thin veil or a thick sheet is read from aidtau_median: under 0.92 thin, 4.6 or more thick; in between a veil that the colour measure counts as closed. l0mid (2.3 km, above the deck's top at 355 m, looking 8 degrees up so the deck is seen under the horizon on the sea): ground_closed_share of l0mid at least 0.5 (the deck now lies on the sea at map 0.859; start 51's l0in/l0up read 0.054 / 0.077 with the sunk deck), and aidtau_median over the sea region 0.92 or more; if l0mid stays under 0.15 the sunk deck was not the whole cause. The sheet layer L1 alone at the low pick (aid1wC5o1): the tau median 4.6 or more if the sheet is thick (the colour measure's 0.86 for C5), under 0.92 if it is a veil. (G) HostGate (package A): the log has no 'NOT STARTED' line and the Atmospheres module starts (the T09 probe runs at all). (B) The beige cast of the sheets is still present in the pictures (nothing in this start changes the colour). (R) The horizon-line rows exist for every natural frame whose horizon row is inside 0.03 to 0.97 of the picture (all views here). A pose or stack the probe cannot read is named, never faked.

REWORK OF THIS START (2026-11-13, after the cross-check of start 52 / order52; the frames and expectations of the original text below stay as they are unless named here). CFG NOTE (FL-FIX): the cumulus layer of the shipped cfg is now a cell field (noiseAmount 1, noiseScaleM 500, f8f8cafe; start 52 drew a sheet at 0.35 / 5000), so the statements below that call the low-cover sky a closed 'sheet' overhead (R1 to R3, the horizon frames) describe start 52's draw, and the closed share of a frame is the oracle's expect_closed_* of the frame (start 53 read 0.79 at ground_low against 0.99); the look sets of the CloudLookModel start from that base. NEW FRAMES AND ROWS. (1) The noise floor: a second baseline frame off2 in every pair and at the horizon pose, the repeats t0b (after the light variants) and hz0h0b (after the fade frames); every difference between two frames is read against the difference between a frame and its repeat. (2) The order pair (cloud.afterScatterer 1 / 0, the switch of start 52) at the horizon pose (200 m, +2 degrees, low cover: the sheet is overhead, the sea below the row is clear on both sides) in the order 1, 0, 0, 1 (frames ord1, ord0, ord0b, ord1b: a drift over the batch, eye adaptation or the weather writer, falls on both orders alike, and the repeat of each is its floor), with the same checks as in start 52 and the vertical row profile of every order frame, of both baselines and of every horizon frame: rows prof_b<k> (below the horizon row) and prof_a<k> (above it), k 0 to 4, each band 2 percent of the picture's height starting 0.4 percent from the row; per band n, changed (change against the baseline of 0.15 or more), rejected (mound rims and ridge samples: luminance more than 0.08 from the band's median) and the median colour r / g / b of the kept samples with the baseline's br / bg / bb over the same samples (T09Readout.MeasureRowProfile). kt2d.py: order.<band>.d_r / d_g / d_b (mean of ord0 and ord0b minus mean of ord1 and ord1b), floor (the larger repeat difference, largest channel), moves (1 when the largest d exceeds 0.02 and twice the floor), gap_ord1 / gap_ord0 (largest channel of deck colour minus baseline colour: a deck that fades into the haze approaches 0 towards the row). (3) The sun's path through the air together with the full tint: air1t10 (beside t0, t5, t10, e14, air1). (4) At the high cover the rain deck alone from 8.3 km (view above, frame l0up) and from 2.3 km (view deck, frame l0mid): the baseline, the deck, <frame>sh0 (the cloud shadows off through the setting cloudShadows, put back after the frame), <frame>all (every layer drawn), aid1<frame> (optical depth) and aid4<frame> (direct light r, light taps g, ambient b; rows direct_median, direct_r_p10, direct_r_p90, taps_median, ambient_median; the pass has no separate shadow channel, the cloud's shadow on itself is part of the direct term). (5) The same order frames (ord1, ord0, ord0b, ord1b, with the row profile) from above at the low cover (view above: the deck lies over the sea at 20 to 60 km), and there the frames hh1 and hh2: the pass's own aerial perspective forced on (cloud.farHaze 1) at the strength 1 and 2 (cloud.hazeStrength) with the order at its default. EXPECTED RESULTS OF THE REWORK, written before the start, each with its basis. (R1) [READ: LightTau in ReDefinitionAtmospheresCloudLight.cginc loops over every layer of the stack, while the layer mask (_LimitP.z) only limits the view march] The dark soft-edged neutral patches of the layer-alone frames of start 52 (l0mid, l0in, l0up, 0.33 grey against 0.8) are the shadow of the hidden layers L1 and above on the rain deck, not a defect of the deck: in l0upall and l0midall the layers above the deck are drawn where the patches were; aid4 direct_r_p10 is under half of direct_r_p90 for l0up and l0mid (patches against lit deck) while ambient_median is the same as in l0up's lit part; l0upsh0 / l0midsh0 equal l0up / l0mid within the floor (deck median and p10 differ by at most 0.02: the cloud shadow's buffers run at AfterScreenspaceMask or AfterForwardOpaque, before the pass at BeforeForwardAlpha, and the pass reads no shadow texture). If sh0 differs by more than 0.03 the rig does touch the deck and the read is wrong. If direct_r_p10 is not under half of direct_r_p90, the patches are not shadows of the hidden layers. (R2) [MEASURED from the saved pictures of start 52, above_low, neutral deck pixels that changed by 0.15 or more, bands of 2 percent below the horizon row; deck 20 to 32 km away at 15.8 to 19.7 degrees below the horizontal from 8.3 km] ord0 minus ord1 in the deck colour: +0.016 / +0.040 / +0.071 (r / g / b) at 15.8 degrees, +0.008 / +0.031 / +0.062 at 19.7 degrees. [COMPUTED from Scatterer's Kerbin config (Rayleigh 0.0153 / 0.0357 / 0.0875 per km, Mie 0.0135 per km, scale heights 3.84 and 1 km) with the sea's haze colour 0.65 / 0.73 / 0.77 as the in-scatter and a deck at 0.3 to 1 km] +0.00 / +0.03 / +0.09: the order switch changes the deck by Scatterer's air where Scatterer reaches the pixel. In the nearest bands of the row (a dark ridge, 0.39 neutral in both orders, 31 to 57 km away) the difference is 0.00, where the same arithmetic gives +0.08 / +0.18 / +0.32: the pass has no fade into the haze there in either order [SUSPECTED: Scatterer's screen-space scattering does not reach those pixels, depth beyond the local camera's range]. At the horizon pose of this start: below the row (clear sea) d_r / d_g / d_b are within the floor (at most 0.02) in all five bands; above the row (the far rim of the sheet seen from below: the pixels have no scene depth, and Scatterer's shader discards them) d_b is at most +0.06 and each channel is 0 or more, the floor at most 0.02; a d_b above the row over 0.06 would mean that Scatterer's air reaches sky pixels too. The gap to the baseline above the row is the deck against the sky's haze: where it stays over 0.15 at the band nearest the row the deck does not fade into the horizon in either order. (R3) The repeats: off against off2, t0 against t0b, hz0h0 against hz0h0b, ord1 against ord1b, ord0 against ord0b differ by at most 0.02 in each channel of each band with 20 or more kept samples (the floor; start 52's thin-column line metric had about 0.03); a difference between two frames under twice its floor is no effect. (R4) The light variants as in the original text: deck_b over deck_r at t0 under 0.80, rising with the tint to 0.85 to 1.0 at t10; air1t10 at least air1's ratio; e14 at 1.16 times t0 while under the white; sky_over_off_sky and ground_over_off_ground 1.0 +- 0.05. (R5) The horizon frames as in the original text (A7). (R6) [COMPUTED from Scatterer's Kerbin config and the log line 'own clouds: air of Kerbin: Rayleigh 5.8e-6 / 3.3e-5 per m, scale height 6067 m' of start 52, the same path integral for both] The pass's own aerial perspective (cloud.farHaze 1, default strength) carries about half of Scatterer's optical depth on Kerbin (tau ratio 2.0 to 2.2 in each channel for a deck at 0.3 to 1 km seen from 8.3 km); with the order 1 (the pass behind Scatterer's air) the frames from above at the low cover are read as hh1 (strength 1) and hh2 (strength 2): in the bands 20 to 32 km away (the bands 3 and 4 below the row of the view from above) hh2 minus ord0 is within 0.03 in every channel while hh1 minus ord0 is blue-short by 0.03 to 0.05 (ord0 minus ord1 is +0.06 to +0.07 in blue there); in the nearest bands of the row hh1 and hh2 both lift the dark ridge toward the baseline (gap_hh1 and gap_hh2 under the gap of ord1, which is 0.26 there), where ord0 does not. If hh2 minus ord0 exceeds 0.05 in the 20 to 32 km bands the pass's in-scatter colour or distance is off, not only the strength. Frames: about 63, 7 to 9 minutes; the probe's limit is 12 minutes. ORIGINAL TEXT. E40 start 52, look B (light and surface). The same pairs (ground low, ground high, above low): the baseline, then the sun tint 0 / 0.5 / 1 (cloud.sunTint: t0, t5, t10), the exposure 1.4 (e14), the sun's path through the air with Scatterer loaded (air1, cloud.sunAirWithScatterer 1), the sun colour of the pass as rows (sun_r / _g / _b), the aid frame of the direct light, taps and ambient (aid4); at the low cover the horizon pose (200 m, pitch +2 degrees) with the distance fade 0 / 20 / 40 / 80 km (cloud.fadeFarM) with the aerial perspective off and on (cloud.farHaze), frames hz<km>h<0|1>, with the band above the horizon as rows (horizon_band_n, horizon_band_closed, horizon_band_change: the share and the median change of a channel against the baseline in the 4 percent of the height above the horizon line) and the oracle's expectation beside each. EXPECTED RESULTS, written before the start: (1) A5: the deck's blue over red (deck_b / deck_r) at t0 is under 0.80 (beige: the sun colour b/r of 0.69 at 45 degrees) and rises monotonically with the tint to 0.85 to 1.0 at t10; sky_over_off_sky and ground_over_off_ground stay 1.0 +- 0.05 in every frame, deck_clipped under 0.001; e14 raises the deck by 1.4 ^ (1 / 2.2) = 1.16 against t0 where it is below the white; air1 changes the sun colour only if Scatterer is loaded (the rows sun_r / _b show it); (2) A7: at hz0h0 the band above the horizon is closed where the sheet is (horizon_band_closed near the sheet's share) with a change of 0.15 or more; with the fade 20 and 40 km the band above the horizon is faded (the player: the deck's alpha in the 0 to 2 degrees above the horizon is 1.00 at no fade, 0.00 at 20 km, 0.003 at 40 km, 1.00 at 80 km, because the layer lies 40 to 50 km away at the horizon), so horizon_band_change falls under 0.10 at 20 and 40 km; the aerial perspective (h1) changes the colour of the far deck toward the sky but not its alpha, so horizon_band_closed is the same at h0 and h1 to 0.05; (3) the expectation rows are written before each frame as in start 51. The plain against recon pair of the plan's start 52 needs the K-T2 variants machinery (the cloudResolution levels) and rides in the K-T2 own1707 set of start 53. About 30 frames, 3 to 4 minutes.

E40 grain (.local/plans/atmospheres/E40-grain-result.md; T09ProbeGrain.cs): the per-pixel speckle of the own clouds in the game. At the low cover, in the ground view and the view from above: the baseline frame (no layer drawn), then seven variants, three frames each read one after the other and written at FULL size (frames <variant>a / b / c): g0 (the pass before this package: recon.accumulate 0), gacc (recon.accumulate 0.2: the half-size march blended into a history of its own size), gleap (layers.gridFine 4 with layers.emptyLeap 4: a grid four times finer that leaps over empty samples), gleapacc (both), gramp (the leap plus layers.entryRamp 4: the entry of a cloud found by bisection, the steps doubling from it), grampacc, gb2 (cloudResolution 2, the 2 x 2 block mode). Rows T09d.<view>.low.<variant>.grain_n / grain_tstd (the standard deviation of a pixel's luma over the three frames, mean over the pixels the clouds changed against the baseline by 0.05 or more) / grain_hf / grain_hf_off / grain_hfx (mean |3 x 3 Laplacian| of the luma over the same pixels, of frame a, of the baseline, their difference) / grain_frames / grain_cuts / mode, and the rows of every frame as in the other starts. Expected, written before the start (.local/work/e40-gn-start54-review.md): grain_tstd of gacc at most half of g0's in both views; gleap below g0; gleapacc and grampacc lowest; no shader or probe fault; every variant's mode row names the path (plain for g0, gleap, gramp; reconstruct for the others). About 6 minutes of scenario.

E40 game start 55 (T09ProbeLook55.cs, -atmoLook C; the default of the product is now recon.accumulate 0.2, so every frame without forced keys is the 'reconstruct' pass). Low cover, ground view: off, off2, (a) colour of the deck's underside: ca02t0 / ca02t5 / ca02t10 (light.ambientOcclusion 0.02 with cloud.sunTint 0 / 0.5 / 1), caDt0 / caDt5 / caDt10 (the default 1.2765), cair (cloud.sunAirWithScatterer 1), ce14 (exposure 1.4), csky0 / csky1 (light.skyTint 0 / 1), caDt0b (repeat); (d) fog rule: wC5o0 and kC5 without and with cloud.typeFair.Kerbin-weather-rain 0.5 (frames ...f), aid frames of the layer-alone pair; (c) grain: gacc (the default) and gleapacc (layers.gridFine 4 + layers.emptyLeap 4), three frames each, rows grain_*; cost windows of 35 s (lines 'T09 view begin / end: <view> <variant> <WxH>' for kt2.py, GPU profiler with -redefinitionGpuProfileNoCameras): off / plain / leap / shape0 (shadow.shapeNoise 0). Horizon pose: off, off2, the order pair 1, 0, 0, 1 with the row profile (b). Above view: off, ord1 / ord0 / ord0b / ord1b, hh1 / hh2 (cloud.farHaze 1 at strength 1 and 2), kC5 / kC5f, sh1 / sh0 (shadow.shapeNoise), the grain pair (skipped after 11 min) and the cost windows off / plain / leap (skipped after 12 min). High cover (only before 12.5 min): the cumulonimbus layer alone at the ground view and the rain deck alone from 2.3 km with cloud.layerNoiseSizeScale.<layer> 1 / 0.1 / 0.05, natural and optical depth (frames f<layer>s100 / s10 / s5). Expected results, written before the start, with their basis: .local/work/e40-start55-review.md. kt2d.py prints the colour b/r, grain, fog, noise-scale and shadow notes and the cost rows T09d.<view>.cost55.<variant>.* (frame, busy, labels, differences against plain). Limit 17 minutes of scenario.

E40 grain against TVC (.local/plans/atmospheres/E40-grain-tvc-result.md; T09ProbeGt.cs, -atmoLook H): the march over the altitudes of the cloud types present with the height variation's reach as the maps hold it around the camera (layers.spanTight) and the golden-ratio sequence of the step offset (layers.ditherSequence), in the fair-weather scene of the look starts (the low cover). Ground view and view from above: the baseline frame, then three frames each of gbefore (layers.spanTight 0, layers.ditherSequence 0, layers.gridFine 1, recon.accumulate 0.2: the pass before the package), gnew (the defaults), gnew10 (recon.accumulate 0.1) and gnewramp (layers.entryRamp 2), written at full size; rows T09d.<view>.low.<variant>.grain_tstd / grain_hf / grain_hfx / grain_n / grain_frames / grain_cuts / mode / spans. Then cost windows of 35 s: off (no layer drawn), before, plain (the defaults) and ramp between 'T09 view begin / end' lines, read by kt2.py as the busy difference against off (the GPU profiler with its camera markers). About 9 minutes of scenario.

E40 grain against TVC, package 2 (T09ProbeGt.cs Look58Cover, -atmoLook H with the start id gt58): the surface march (layers.surfaceMarch 3: a cloud's entry by three bisections, the step inside by optical depth, the light marched once per entry) in the fair-weather scene. Ground view and view from above: the baseline, three frames each of gbefore (the pass before E40 grain against TVC), gsurf (layers.spanTight 1 with the surface march), gsurfw (the surface march on the type table's whole interval) and gsurfe (gsurf with layers.surfaceLight 1: the light once per entry), rows grain_* / spans as in gt57; then cost windows of 35 s: off, before, surf, surfw, surfe. About 10 minutes of scenario.
